title: PAVOQUE Corpus of Expressive Speech
task: acted expressive speech: neutral, happy, sad, angry, poker/cool; outtakes
token_or_recording_size: six public YAML annotation files plus linked FLAC releases
annotation_target: utterance boundaries; text; speaking style; manually corrected SAMPA phonetic segments with relative end times
manual_scope: segments are explicitly documented as manually corrected; source YAML preserves per-utterance times and optional segment labels/end times
access: public GitHub repository and release assets
decision_reason: Primary non-singing German expressive speech with directly accessible manually corrected phonetic segmentation and explicit timing semantics.
evidence_summary: Repository README identifies a single native German professional actor as speaker, describes 44.1-kHz 16-bit mono primary audio, and states that YAML files contain optionally manually corrected SAMPA phonetic segments with segment end times relative to utterance start. The corpus is expressive spoken performance, not singing; the speaker's opera training is biographical only.
